contentText: Progressive ⁠Bulgaria, the ​party of Bulgaria's ​pro-Russian former President Rumen Radev was leading in ​Sunday's ‌parliamentary ⁠election with 44.59% ‌of votes, after 32% of ⁠votes were counted, official results ​showed. Radev, a eurosceptic ‌and former fighter pilot who opposes military ‌support for Ukraine's ​war effort against Moscow, stepped down from the ​presidency in January ​to run ​in the parliamentary election, ​which comes after mass protests forced out the previous government ⁠in December. FRANCE 24's Elitsa Gadeva tells us more.
